note: Hebrew yerekh (literally "thigh") here denotes the base or stem of the lampstand; the phrase means "from base to blossoms", i.e. the whole piece.

kjv: offer the Levites before the LORD [for] an offering
mine: present the Levites before Yahweh as a wave offering
note: Hebrew henif ... tenufah is the technical "wave offering" (elevation) ritual; the KJV's generic "offering" obscures that the Levites are dedicated like a waved portion. Also 8:13, 8:15, 8:21.
